quests.storyParagraph: Fenna had cleared her Saturday to finish an overdue tax return. A knock at the door interrupted her at the kitchen table. Her neighbor stood there, apologizing: his car would not start and he had a flight to catch. Fenna weighed the return against his flight and chose the flight. Fenna fetched her jumper cables and drove her car alongside his. The engine caught, and he sped off with a wave. Fenna returned to the kitchen table, her concentration scattered. The return got finished on Sunday, with a note to herself to file it early next year.

Ivo restarted the piece, and the sopranos' tone was clear. He decided to keep the hall warmer for the concert.
